name: Angie's Restaurant Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup & Roast Beef French Dip
whyItWorks: Angie's tender egg-noodle chicken soup and thin-sliced roast beef French Dip on a soft hoagie roll dipped in warm au jus soften in the mouth and digest cleanly with minimal fat or fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a cup or bowl of Homemade Chicken Noodle Soup paired with a half or full Roast Beef French Dip (plain beef and Swiss cheese on the roll, dipped in warm au jus).
watchOuts: Au jus is high in sodium, which is helpful for hydration during flares, but skip creamy soups like broccoli cheddar unless taking lactase
